phase_firewall.t0_t1_rows: pitfall rows whose frozen event map is BALA1 or BALA2
phase_firewall.t2_rows: pitfall rows whose frozen event map is BALA3
phase_firewall.nonpitfall_rows: ignored for primary analysis and never used to infer absence

taxon_scope.rule: exactly the frozen v1.137 pilot taxonomic rule

transition_population.primary_loss_count: exactly one t0 occupied island absent at t1
transition_population.target: island occupied at t1 and different from the lost source
transition_population.if_failed: STOP before BALA3 semantic access; do not widen taxon scope or loss-count rule

source_operator.lost_access_fraction_E_i: graph-kernel mass from the one lost t0 source divided by graph-kernel mass from all t0 sources excluding target self

reference_R2.island_state: six target-island dummy variables with FAI as reference; this saturated static island control absorbs time-invariant area, external isolation, environment and generic network differences across the seven islands
reference_R2.empty_source_encoding: nearest distance = 0 and diffuse pressure = 0 when no surviving other source; surviving_source_empty=1 distinguishes this state
reference_R2.continuous_standardization: pilot training mean and population SD; zero variance is STOP

model.training_endpoint: 1 = BALA2 target absent at BALA3; 0 = target persists to BALA3

freeze_before_t2_access: eligible confirmatory MF token set from t0/t1 only
R2 and C probability for every confirmatory target row

future_scoring.primary_estimand: equal-weight mean across confirmatory taxon clusters of within-taxon mean binary-log-loss(C)-binary-log-loss(R2)
future_scoring.support_rule: point < 0 and taxon-cluster bootstrap 95% upper bound < 0
future_scoring.secondary_direction: greater E_i predicts greater probability of subsequent contraction; cannot rescue failed primary
